These commands are available three ways — in the FREE-WILi GUI app, in a serial
terminal, and on the device itself. See
[Connecting it to a computer](../start-here/connecting.md) for how to reach them.

## Baud Rate

UART baud rate in bits per second

**How to use it** — press `f`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## RTS Hand Shaking

Enable RTS hardware handshaking

**How to use it** — press `r`.

## CTS Hand Shaking

Enable CTS hardware handshaking

**How to use it** — press `c`.

## Data Bits

UART data bits

**How to use it** — press `b`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## Parity

UART parity mode

**How to use it** — press `p`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## Stop Bits

UART stop bits

**How to use it** — press `s`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## Module

Which UART module handles the port

**How to use it** — press `m`.

**What you enter** — `value`.
